english.note: This is the everyday all-purpose noun for a person's planned course of action.
Use this when the notion is an intention or plan to do something.
Use this when counsel means someone's intended plan, purpose, or design rather than advice.

examples.english: My intention is to move house next month.
examples.jyutping: ngo5 daa2 syun3 haa6 go3 jyut6 bun1 uk1

examples.english: We have a notion to move house next month.
examples.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 daa2 syun3 haa6 go3 jyut6 bun1 uk1

examples.english: Their counsel is to move to Taiwan next year.
examples.traditional: 佢嘅打算係下年搬去台灣。
examples.jyutping: keoi5 ge3 daa2 syun3 hai6 haa6 nin2 bun1 heoi3 toi1 waan1
